desc: Murloc Maraca: a party maraca carved and painted to look like a little grinning murloc, its fins as the rattle, bright tropical paint, held up as if mid-shake

The Barrel: the old joke - the ogre wears nothing but a big wooden barrel with iron hoops, held up by two leather braces (suspenders) over the bare shoulders; bare ogre chest and arms above the barrel's rim

Do Not Disturb Sign: a hotel door-hanger sign saying DO NOT DISTURB in neat lettering, cream card with a gold border and a little sleeping-moon picture, held up on a short wooden stick like a picket sign

Sleeping Bag: a puffy quilted camping sleeping bag in moss green and orange, zipped all the way up to the chin, the ogre snug inside it; its hood is NOT over the head - it lies flat behind the shoulders, the whole head free

Bent Halo: a ghostly glowing pale-gold halo floating just above the head, bent and wonky as if it had been sat on, a few faint spirit sparkles round it. It floats above the head; the face is fully visible
White Flag: a small, slightly grubby white cloth flag of truce on a thin wooden stick, held up limply, the cloth drooping
Neck Pillow: a plump U-shaped travel neck pillow in soft sky-blue fleece with little gryphon prints, worn round the neck, resting on the shoulders

Godz-Touched: a misty mountain clearing at dusk where a huge golden beam of light pours down from parting storm clouds, glittering gold coins drifting in it, giant grumpy ogre faces of the Ogre Godz carved into the cliffs around, warm holy glow on the mossy ground
